profile.headline: Web Developer at The Platta Law Firm
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced Jr. Web Developer specialized in WordPress. I do everything on WordPress websites like modifying themes, WooCommerce, Google Analytics, Facebook Pixels, SEO optimization, site speed optimization, setting up environments, launching sites on WP Engine, Captcha, installing plugins, etc. I work with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and some PHP. Besides that, I can also help you with your cPanel, integrations, FTP, Webmail, etc. I have two years of Marketing Agency experience.

I’m a strong Web Designer with a keen eye for design. I specialize in clean, modern, and responsive websites. Within WordPress, I use Elementor page builder. Elementor is a powerful tool that allows me to design any template to match the desired look and feel you are looking for in your website. My web designs look fantastic on any device. It doesn’t matter the screen size. Whether it be a smartphone, a tablet, a laptop, or a desktop, even on a TV screen, your website will look fabulous. It will be 100% responsive.

I’m skilled in Photoshop and similar software. I'm also an experienced Content Writer. Besides, I’m talented in Video and Audio editing.

Even though WordPress is my go-to platform when developing a website, regularly, I also work on other popular CMSs (Content Management Systems) out there, among them: Joomla, Magento, Wix, SquareSpace, Shopify, dealership CMSs, and other customized ones. Same with page builders. Elementor is my favorite one, but I usually work on Divi, King Composer, Beaver Builder, SP Page Builder, and others.

I have worked for several Marketing Agencies. I keep up to date with the latest trends in website development and design. My portfolio includes more than 35 WordPress websites, from e-Commerce to blogs.

Portfolio: www.linebreik.com
